progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on G in Daramad I-Rast. The line peaks at C5 (519.0 Hz) at 1:37.8. It closes on the tonic (D3 → G3 → F3 → C5 → E3 → F3).

flags: tonic F set in the catalog (the Rast-Panjgah suite's finalis F: Daramad II and ten gushe-ha end on it; read from it the suite has Rast's leading tone (the 2nd below, 4% of played time), which the other candidate, its 5th C, lacks (0.3%); Farhat 1990, pp. 100-101. Borumand's Nava on the same volume sits a tone above it, as in Farhat's keys; the vote picked the 5th. Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 518.1 Hz (C)
